implementation.name: original-v1-rollback-compatible-bundles
implementation.scope: Original rollback figure with six labeled toy request markers; no request counts, rates, durations, or drain timeout from the chapter. Admission pins the complete bundle; movement pace is illustrative.
implementation.question: When can the candidate bundle be released after rollback?

purpose: Follow toy requests pinned at admission through cutover, coexistence, a refused cross-version pairing, cancellation, and drain; Bundle 2 is released only after its last pinned consumer, and the degraded-window logs stay flagged.

storyboard.label: Bundle 2 is the routing target
storyboard.description: R1-R4 carry the complete Bundle 2; Bundle 1 is a loaded standby; their records fall in the degraded window.

storyboard.label: Cutover selects Bundle 1
storyboard.description: One routing decision changes weights, schema, and namespace together; no admitted request moves.

storyboard.label: New requests pin to Bundle 1
storyboard.description: R5 and R6 take the solid green path; both bundles serve at once.

storyboard.label: Pinned requests finish on Bundle 2
storyboard.description: R1 and R2 complete; Bundle 2 in flight 4 to 2.

storyboard.label: Mixed pairing is refused
storyboard.description: Weights 1 with namespace 2 is invalid; R3 stays on Bundle 2 and no counter changes.

storyboard.label: Cancellation of R4 is requested
storyboard.description: A requested cancellation still counts; Bundle 2 stays at 2.

storyboard.label: R4 cancellation is confirmed
storyboard.description: Bundle 2 in flight 2 to 1; R3 is the last consumer.

storyboard.label: Release Bundle 2; logs stay flagged
storyboard.description: Bundle 2 is released; R1-R4 degraded-window records still need quarantine or repair. Cost: both bundles stayed loaded through the drain.

guard: Toy request markers only: no counts, rates, latencies, or drain timeout. No request ever changes bundle after admission; cancellation is not instantaneous; Bundle 2 is never released before its in-flight count reaches 0; reverting routing does not repair logs. Stateful namespace framing, not a stateless blue-green flip.
